question: If (x + 6y) = 8, and xy = 2, where x > 0, what is the value of (x³ + 216y³)?
solution:
**Given:**

(x + 6y) = 8

xy = 2

**Formula used:**

(a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab (a + b)

**Calculation:**

xy = 2

⇒ y = 2/x .....(1)

Also, (x + 6y) = 8

⇒ x + (6 × 2/x) = 8

⇒ x + 12/x = 8 .....(2)

⇒ (x + 12/x)³ = 8³ [Taking cube of both sides]

⇒ x³ + (12/x)³ + 3 × x × (12/x) (x + 12/x) = 512

⇒ x3 + (12/x)3 + 3 × 12 × 8 = 512 [∵ We get from equation (2), x + 12/x = 8]

⇒ x3 + (12/x)3 + 288 = 512

⇒ x3 + (12/x)3 = 512 - 288

⇒ x3 + [(2 × 6)/x]³ = 224

⇒ x3 + (6y)³ = 224 [∵ y = 2/x]

⇒ x3 + 216y³ = 224

**∴ The value of x3 + 216y3 is 224**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**Using Formula - (a + b)3 = a3 + b3 + 3ab (a + b)

(x + 6y)³ = x³ + 216y³ + 3 × x × 6y(x + 6y)

Put (x + 6y) = 8, xy = 2

⇒ 8³ = x3 + 216y3 + 3 × 6 × 2 × 8

⇒ x3 + 216y3 = 512 - 288

⇒ x3 + 216y3 = 224

∴ The value of x3 + 216y3 is 224.
